name: plan-usage-01
title: 套餐与用量
description: An embedded subscription workspace with usage, limits, plans, payment details and invoices.

files.content:
import type { PlanUsageLabels } from "./plan-usage-types";
export const planUsageDefaultLabels: PlanUsageLabels = {
    title: "Plan & usage",
    description: "What you’ve used, what you pay and your invoices.",
    active: "Active",
    canceled: "Cancellation scheduled",
    perMonth: "a month",
    renewal: (date, price) => `Renews on ${date}. Next charge ${price}.`,
    usage: "Usage this cycle",
    included: (total) => `of ${total} included credits`,
    remaining: (credits, days) => `${credits} left · resets in ${days} days`,
    progress: (used, total) => `${used} of ${total} included credits used`,
    projected: (credits) => `Projected ${credits}`,
    alertAt: (percent) => `Alert at ${percent}`,
    depletion: (date, days) => `At this pace you’ll run out around ${date}, ${days} days before your credits reset.`,
    enableExtraUsage: "Turn on extra usage",
    seePlans: "See plans",
    dailyUsage: "Daily usage",
    today: (credits) => `Today, ${credits} credits so far`,
    evenPace: (credits) => `Even pace, ${credits} a day`,
    projectionNote: "Projections use your last 7 days.",
    emptyUsage: "No usage recorded in this cycle.",
    limits: "Limits",
    usageAlert: "Usage alert",
    usageAlertDescription: "Email me at this share of included credits.",
    extraUsage: "Extra usage",
    extraUsageDescription: "Keep agents running after included credits run out, up to a monthly limit.",
    extraUsageNote: (price) => `Extra usage costs ${price} per 100 credits and is added to your next invoice.`,
    plans: "Plans",
    current: "Current",
    yourPlan: "Your plan",
    downgrade: "Downgrade",
    upgrade: "Upgrade",
    payment: "Payment",
    paymentCard: (brand, last4) => `${brand} ending in ${last4}`,
    paymentDetails: (expires, holder) => `Expires ${expires} · ${holder}`,
    noPayment: "No payment method on file.",
    update: "Update",
    invoices: "Invoices",
    date: "Date",
    invoiceDescription: "Description",
    amount: "Amount",
    status: "Status",
    paid: "Paid",
    refunded: "Refunded",
    download: (id) => `Download invoice ${id}`,
    showOlder: (count) => `Show ${count} older`,
    emptyInvoices: "No invoices yet.",
    cancelPlan: "Cancel plan",
    cancelDescription: (plan, date) => `You keep ${plan} until ${date}. Nothing is deleted.`,
    cancelScheduled: (plan, date) => `${plan} ends on ${date}. Nothing is deleted.`,
};
